title: VERA-MH: Reliability and Validity of an Open-Source AI Safety Evaluation in Mental Health
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith/religion. The VERA-MH benchmark measures AI safety in mental health contexts, specifically focusing on suicide risk detection and response in simulated chatbot conversations.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion as it is not a focus of the study.
